review_text: My order took 45 minutes to arrive and the waiter kept giving excuses.
The delivery was extremely slow, almost an hour late.
We waited way too long for our food while other tables were being served.
The wait time was unacceptable, 50 minutes for a simple pasta dish.
Took forever to bring out our appetizers.
The food was served cold and lacked any fresh aroma.
My meal was lukewarm, definitely not hot enough.
Soup arrived icy cold, had to send it back to the microwave.
The burger was stone cold and the cheese was hard.
Chicken curry was barely warm when it reached our table.
The paneer was stale and smelled sour.
The meat was tough and rubbery, completely unseasoned.
Biryani lacked flavor and the rice was uncomfortably dry.
Gravy tasted artificial and way too salty to eat.
The fish was not fresh and tasted fishy in a bad way.
Found a hair in my salad bowl, completely disgusted.
The cutlery was dirty and had sticky grease spots on the fork.
Tables were sticky and the water glasses smelled bad.
Saw a fly hovering over the open salad bar, poor hygiene.
Prices are ridiculously high for such tiny portions.
They overcharged us on the bill and added a hidden service fee.
Way overpriced for basic diner food, not worth 800 rupees.
There was a billing error where double drinks were charged.
The waiter was extremely rude and rolled his eyes when we asked for water.
Staff was completely indifferent and ignored us when we called.
The manager was arrogant and refused to apologize for the delay.
Packaging was damaged and the curry spilled all over the paper bag.
The delivery driver was careless and squished the pizza box.
Tamarind chutney leaked through the container into the dessert.
Portion size was laughable, barely three spoonfuls of dal.
Very small serving for a family platter, left the restaurant hungry.
Absolutely sensational butter chicken and the garlic naan was heavenly!
Prompt service, warm hospitality, and the desserts were to die for.
Best dining experience in Bengaluru this year, five stars all around!
Everything was freshly made, piping hot, and full of authentic flavor.
The atmosphere was fine, nothing special to write home about.
It is what it is, decent quick bite on a Tuesday afternoon.
